paragraphs: (Elyakim son of King Josiah, II Kings 24:34.) Rabbi Yose ben Elyakim: Berakhot 9b. Rabbi Shimon ben Elyakim: Ketubot 50b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The verse is printed as II Kings 24:34; Elyakim son of Josiah is renamed in II Kings 23:34.

The supplied II Kings 24:34 label is retained; the positive passage naming Elyakim son of Josiah is II Kings 23:34. Berakhot 9b names Rabbi Yose ben Elyakim and Ketubot 50b Rabbi Shimon ben Elyakim. No identity joins are inferred.
